summary: Selects a rendering function-pointer pair based on the sub_50FC7D() condition: on true it installs sub_503772 into both off_5D76C0 (primary) and off_5D76C4 (secondary); on false it installs ImageBlendingCompositing into off_5D76C0 and F_2DImageBoxFilter into off_5D76C4. It then calls the primary pointer off_5D76C0 and returns its result.

operations.description: Branch on the return value of sub_50FC7D() to select which function-pointer pair to install.
When the guard is true, set the primary pointer off_5D76C0 to sub_503772.
When the guard is true, set the secondary pointer off_5D76C4 to sub_503772.
When the guard is false, set the primary pointer off_5D76C0 to ImageBlendingCompositing.
When the guard is false, set the secondary pointer off_5D76C4 to F_2DImageBoxFilter.
Indirect call through the installed primary pointer off_5D76C0 and return its integer result.

unresolved: What sub_50FC7D() measures (hardware capability, config flag, or render state) is not grounded by the packet.
The secondary pointer off_5D76C4 is written but never consumed inside this function; its downstream consumer is unknown.
Why sub_503772 is used for both slots on the true path while the false path uses two distinct functions is unexplained.
